headline: Monday, 2 days pre-FOMC: sell-the-rip downtrend intact (dollar strength + VIX into support-long + bank into a first traditional short) — watch a Monday gap-up short-covering squeeze then a slam, like last Monday.
market_state: 2 days to FOMC. Econ: durable goods 8:30. Fed-watch: ~2 hikes still priced into 2026 (watch if the 2nd holds). Regime: inflationary bust but BACKTRACKING toward inflationary boom (economy + prices rising -> gold/commodities up) — is it a one-day backtrack or a trend? Dollar-correlation negative on S&P/NASDAQ (Dow/Russell slightly positive); WTI turned positive; gold/silver neutral (fading negative).
bias: BEARISH 'sell the rip': the dollar is in a long-from-lows, VIX is falling into a support-long, and Bank has squeezed into its FIRST traditional short after the trend break — all -> continuation of indices weakness. The backing-and-filling into resistance is 'a feature not a bug' of the downtrend.

es.current_mm: Coming into a full-retracement short from highs->lows; overnight (Sun-night Mon) highs->lows defending a 50% short. Pro gap-up-and-go — reminiscent of Friday and last Monday (gap up -> new trading-hours high -> short-covering squeeze -> slam).
es.trend: Downtrend; sell the rip. Confirmation of weakness = break of the VIX 1945 series / break of the ES week lows->highs longs.

key_levels.label: Longs to break by 9:15-9:30 (else short-covering squeeze)

es.watch: If ES hasn't broken the 7499 week-longs by 9:15-9:30, expect a short-covering squeeze to a new high (like last Monday: opened >30pt from Fri 4pm close, squeezed, then slammed). Below the 30-handle = pro gap-and-go down.

ES.notes: sell the rip; watch Monday squeeze-then-slam

CL.notes: break extension shorts = reconfirm support -> targets 99.74

6E.notes: euro = 57.6% of DXY, the top leading indicator; hasn't broken counter-trends yet

scenarios.thesis: Sell-the-rip continuation: dollar-long + VIX-into-support + bank-short = weakness continues.
scenarios.trigger: break VIX 1945 series / lose ES week longs

scenarios.thesis: Monday gap-up short-covering squeeze to a new high if 7499 longs don't break by 9:15-9:30 (then watch for the slam).
Bank into its FIRST traditional short after the trend break = financials confirm weakness.
Break extension shorts -> reconfirm support -> run to targets (inflationary-boom rotation).
Wedge forming (two opposing 61.8 breaks); dollar-correlation turning positive -> sideways-to-higher.
scenarios.trigger: hold original support / correlation flips positive

scenarios.thesis: New traditional short; repeated 38.2 front-runs = clean dollar-strength/euro-weakness.

key_quotes.text: We're in a sell-the-rip type environment — the backing and filling that goes on inside the indices is a feature, not a bug of a downtrend.
If we haven't broken through these long setups... there's a potential short-covering squeeze, and we'll watch to see if there's a slam (like last Monday).
A wedge forming while the dollar correlations go from negative to neutral to positive would be perfect... we anticipate precious metals go sideways to higher.

other_notes: 2 days pre-FOMC. VIX bull>1760 (confirm support by breaking 1945 series). DXY bull>108.08; dollar-support confirms >101.381. USD/JPY bull>163.27 (multi-decade yen lows; a break = yen strength + dollar strength = carry unwind). Crypto: BTC intraday 50% short in a H&S; ETH no short-from-highs yet.
